Monday-sweep lesson learned: the API (export.arxiv.org) rate-limits hard after a few paged queries and stays blocked for >30min — /list/<cat>/recent?skip=N&show=250 pagination covers the last 5 announcement days reliably and was the working fallback (show must be one of 25/50/100/250/500/1000/2000; search/advanced date filters did not apply; category filter on /search/advanced is ignored). Digest-day headers in /recent map directly to announcement dates for published_at attribution (Mon 31 Aug = Fri 8/28 submissions etc.).
